_about: Every fish in the game so far, easiest first. A fish's fight is one or more sections; each section is one fight-box mode (an id from fight_modes.json) with a difficulty range [from, to] on the 0 (easy) .. 1 (hard) scale. The section starts at 'from' and climbs to 'to' as its meter fills. Names follow the two-language rule (see CLAUDE.md); Sanbi is canon. 'pearls' is the reward range [min, max]. See docs/white-paper/06-fish-fights.md.

fish.name: Karkoi
fish.description: A lazy pond fish. It drifts about and gives up quickly.

fish.name: Bagnazu
fish.description: A heavy bottom-feeder. Reel it up, then keep up as it wanders.

fish.name: Magatum
fish.description: Fast and strong. Set the hook, survive its runs, then match its tail beat.

fish.name: Sanbi
fish.description: Placeholder fight for the canon fish. Ignore its decoys, hold steady, and keep going when you lose sight of it.
